title: Chapter 47
text: ∫ when everything seems like suicide finality and the Black Hearse from Hell is running through me with its flat tires, leaky radiator, the headless chauffeur flogging off a bag of paperclips — stinking screams running like greyhounds through my plastic brain bags I check out my 5 cats. I check their bungholes ears paws eyelashes, their fissures, their fix, their fondle, their IBM electricity, their eyes bleeding from the center of the fire and they look at me and say through the irises: be calm, the sea is your blood, the moon is one of your balls — the big left one — and your automobile sits in the garage waiting on you patiently and even your wife loves you. you are making too much of nothing, watch us and learn the cool: brave is beautiful, we are all together in nowhere and that’s splendid, July and circumference are the same thing and asshole you don’t even have to lick and scratch, exactly. it has worked so far: the 5 best cats in the world. Manx
